newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen rebounding on bargain hunting.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen rebounding on bargain hunting.

text.p: Thai stocks are expected to move higher on Wednesday on bargain hunting following the recent sharp fall in the index, brokers said.
An overnight surge on Wall Street will also help boost market sentiment here, they said.
"Bargain hunters will begin to snap up cheap shares today. The fading worry of (higher) interest rates abroad will also trigger buying," a broker at Nava Finance and Securities said.
The SET index closed off 13.89 points or 2.07 percent on Tuesday on 3.8 billion baht trade. -- Anuchit Nguyen (662) 652-0642
